title: I–II. Names of eternal death; receiving subject the impious
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): The receiving subject stand as ye impious who do not have true plus heavenly wisdom, nor ye wedding garment belonging toward Christ's righteousness through faith, not obeying ye Gospel, but worshiping ye beast — ye fearful, unbelieving, fornicators, idolaters, plus ye like. II. || out from place plus reception hell, prison, furnace belonging toward fire, place belonging toward torments, lake plus winepress belonging toward wrath, lake belonging toward fire, pit, chains belonging toward darkness, Gehenna, eternal fire, outer darkness. 6:2 eternal damnation; plus Heb. 4:19; also Wis. 1:8–9, where it stands as called eternal destruction; The nomenclature belonging toward eternal death stands as taken out from 2 Thess. I.
pass_b_english: I. The nomenclature of eternal death is taken from 2 Thess. 1:8–9, where it is called eternal destruction; also Wis. 4:19; and Heb. 6:2 eternal damnation; from place and reception hell, prison, furnace of fire, place of torments, lake and winepress of wrath, lake of fire, pit, chains of darkness, Gehenna, eternal fire, outer darkness.

II. The receiving subject are the impious who do not have true and heavenly wisdom, nor the wedding garment of Christ's righteousness through faith, not obeying the Gospel, but worshiping the beast — the fearful, unbelieving, fornicators, idolaters, and the like.
source_text: I. Mortis aeternae nomenclatura petita est ex 2 Thess. 1.8–9, ubi dicitur aeternus interitus; & Sap. 4.v.19; & Heb. 6.v.2 aeterna damnatio; a loco & receptu infernus, Es. 5; carcer; caminus ignis; locus tormentorum; lacus & torcular irae; stagnum ignis; fovea; catenae tenebrarum; gehenna; ignis aeternus; tenebrae exteriores. II. Subjectum recipiens sunt impii non habentes veram & caelestem sapientiam, nec vestem nuptialem Christi justitiam per fidem, non obedientes Evangelio, sed adorantes bestiam, timidi, increduli, fornicatores, idololatrae, &c.
